[Shot 1] A medium frame at seated eye level on <Subject 1>, seen from head to boots in the green velvet armchair at the centre of the frame, his stocky body facing screen left; the white marble fireplace with its black iron grate stands at the left, the dark panelled door at the right, the crimson rug on the floorboards below. The camera holds a static shot.
